period_note: Extracted from UCB's own Half-Yearly unaudited financial statement PDF ('United Commercial Bank PLC Unaudited Financial Statements For the half year ended 30 June 2026'). Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported, Solo/Standalone -- 'BALANCE SHEET' heading without the 'CONSOLIDATED' prefix, matching the project's Solo-over-Consolidated preference and the same convention used for 2026_Q1.json). Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2026, flagged via the _cumulative suffix. UNUSUALLY, like TRUSTBANK's 2026_Q2.json and EBL's 2026_Q2.json, this filing ALSO discloses a discrete second-quarter-only column ('April to June 2026') as a bonus, not stored as separate line_items except net_profit_after_tax_q2_discrete/eps_q2_discrete, used for cross-validation: discrete Q2 Bank Net Profit after Tax of 220,070,261 plus 2026_Q1.json's net_profit_after_tax_cumulative of 192,339,361 (actually 192.34m) = 412,409,622, matching this filing's own H1-cumulative Bank Net Profit after Tax exactly -- confirms both quarters read correctly. EXTRACTION METHOD: figures read directly by visual inspection of 200dpi page renders (pdftoppm) of the specific Solo-labelled pages (this filing interleaves landscape SOCE pages with portrait BS/P&L/CF pages, unlike Q1's all-portrait layout, so pages were located by heading rather than assumed position). Confirmed correct basis: this filing's own 31-Dec-2025 Solo comparative column (Total Assets 884,056,454,596) matches this dataset's stored 2025_Q4.json exactly. As with Q1, this filing has NO loan-classification/NPL note and NO capital-adequacy (CAR/CRAR) note -- npl_ratio_pct, ldr_pct (regulatory basis) and car_pct remain unavailable. VALIDATED: balance-sheet identity holds (Total Liabilities 928,937,018,635 + Total Equity 42,331,719,623 = Total Assets 971,268,738,258, within BDT 1 of the reported 971,268,738,259 rounding); Total Operating Income (15,489,486,775) - Total Operating Expenses (10,895,209,043) = Profit & Loss before provision (4,594,277,732) exactly; minus Total Provision (2,077,550,316) = Total Profit before Income Tax (2,516,727,416) exactly; minus Total Tax (2,104,317,794) = Net profit after Tax, Bank (412,409,622) exactly; the same chain reconciles exactly for the discrete Apr-Jun column too. NAVPS-Bank of 27.30 (Note 7) and NOCFPS-Bank of (16.78) (Note 8, negative -- large loans/advances growth this half outpaced deposit growth in the cash-flow statement) both taken directly from the filing's own Selective Notes. Note 9 (Events after the reporting period) discloses BSEC approved a BDT 775.19 crore rights share issue on 07 July 2026 (after this reporting period) -- a capital-raise, not a risk signal, so not carried into insights.json per project convention (risk_signals only).
